dialogues.speaker: Chizhang Wall Tablet
dialogues.text: "...Evil spirits in Chenyu Vale abound, writhing with malevolent intent. Thereby was the Chizhang Wall, built by the ancestors, rebuilt, to ward off demonic peril..."

dialogues.speaker: Chizhang Wall Tablet
dialogues.text: "...The builders here inscribe their names so that the wall might stand as strong as the immovable Millelith..."
